mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate at or below 0.25% indicates aggressive monetary accommodation, reducing equity discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to immediate capital flow into equities.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.25% (t-test of mean return vs 0, p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of periods when UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months (t-test of mean return vs 0, p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous industrial production decline below 95 and housing starts below 500 thousand units indicates contraction in both manufacturing and construction sectors, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in > 60% of periods when INDPRO < 95 and HOUST < 500 (t-test of mean return vs 0, p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 4.0% during monetary tightening cycles increases cost of capital and reduces equity valuation multiples, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.0% (t-test of mean return vs 0, p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained industrial production level below 95 indicates economic contraction, reducing corporate output and profit expectations, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of periods when INDPRO < 95 (t-test of mean return vs 0, p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 500 thousand units signals weakening residential demand, reducing consumer confidence and corporate sales, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of periods when HOUST < 500 (t-test of mean return vs 0, p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous payroll employment decline below 130,000 thousand and unemployment rate increase above 9.0% indicates severe labor market distress, reducing household income and consumption, which generates negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of periods when PAYEMS < 130000 and UNRATE > 9.0 (t-test of mean return vs 0, p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Real sales (RSAFS) falling below 340,000 million dollars indicates weakening consumer demand, reducing corporate revenue growth expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of periods when RSAFS < 340000 (t-test of mean return vs 0, p > 0.05).
